tools.name: sos_check_rights
tools.description: Checks a cancelled, delayed, overbooked or missed-connection flight against EU261, UK261 and US DOT rules. Returns the law that applies, up to three options (refund, re-routing), the care the airline owes (meals, hotel), a compensation range per passenger with its conditions, warnings and facts that

tools.name: sos_desk_script
tools.description: Writes 1 to 3 short, polite sentences for a traveller to say to the airline agent, asking for re-routing, care or a refund. The sentences are in the traveller's language and cite the regulation that applies.

tools.name: sos_airport_help
tools.description: Lists hotel, lounge and transfer search links for an airport, nearby alternative airports with directions, and who pays for a hotel under EU and UK rules. Links only, nothing is booked. Covers about 100 airports in Europe, North America and Asia.

tools.name: sos_find_alternatives
tools.description: Searches live one-way flights from the traveller's airport and airports within 300 km to their destination on one date, ordered by earliest arrival, with price in EUR, stops, ground distance to the alternative airport and rail operator links for trips under 1,200 km. Returns 10 options per page; tim

tools.name: sos_prepare_case
tools.description: Checks the details for a case handled by the SOS Flights team (rebooking help, hotel, evidence and follow-up) and returns what will be submitted, the price (a one-time fee, or covered by a valid access code) and a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is created or charged. No account is

tools.name: sos_open_case
tools.description: Opens the case prepared with a confirmation_token, after the traveller confirmed it. Returns the case code, which is the key to the case afterwards, the case page and either a payment link (the case becomes active after payment) or, with an access code, an active case.

tools.name: sos_get_case
tools.description: Returns the status of an SOS Flights case by its case code: whether it is active, the team's recommended solution once there is one, the last 10 chat messages for chat cases, and the case page link.

tools.name: sos_prepare_message
tools.description: Checks a message from the traveller to the SOS Flights team on an active chat case and returns it with a confirmation_token valid for 15 minutes. Nothing is sent. WhatsApp cases continue in WhatsApp.

tools.name: sos_send_message
tools.description: Sends the message prepared with a confirmation_token to the SOS Flights team, after the traveller confirmed it. The team's reply appears in the case status and on the case page.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sos_get_case · Public sink: sos_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sos_get_case · Public sink: sos_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
